title: channels__heartbeat — output
description: Output schema for the SOX channels__heartbeat operation. Confirms the server-side liveness record has been updated and returns the server-assigned expiry time. Normative reference: spec/primitives/presence.md.

agent_id.description: The agent_id whose liveness record was updated. Derived from the authenticated connection identity.

status.description: The status recorded by the server. Echoed from input.

recorded_at.description: Unix epoch seconds (floating-point) at which the server recorded this heartbeat.

expires_at.description: Unix epoch seconds (floating-point) at which the server will transition this agent to 'stale' if no further heartbeat is received. Derived from the effective TTL (caller-supplied or server default).
